# Claude Code Projects Index

> A curated index of 337 open-source Claude Code repositories by Daniel Rosehill —
> agent workspaces, plugins, slash commands and MCP tooling, spanning software
> development and non-code domains such as sysadmin, legal, health and research.
> Site: https://claude.danielrosehill.com

Every entry below is a public GitHub repository. The index is maintained in
https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Code-Projects-Index and rebuilt from
markdown category files, so this file always matches the live site.

## Machine-readable data

- [Full index as JSON](https://claude.danielrosehill.com/tagged_repos.json): every repo with name, url, description, tags, category, category_group, slug, created_date and added_date.
- [Category-grouped JSON](https://claude.danielrosehill.com/repos.json): the same repos nested under their categories.
- [Category hierarchy](https://claude.danielrosehill.com/categories.json): category groups, categories and slugs.
- [All repositories, one page](https://claude.danielrosehill.com/browse/): static HTML listing of every repo, grouped by category.
- [Sitemap](https://claude.danielrosehill.com/sitemap-index.xml): every page on the site.

## Installing the plugins

Most entries tagged "Plugin" are distributed through one Claude Code marketplace.
To install, run inside Claude Code:

    /plugin marketplace add danielrosehill/Claude-Code-Plugins
    /plugin install <plugin-name>@danielrosehill

Marketplace source: https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Code-Plugins
Install guide: https://claude.danielrosehill.com/plugins/

## Argument and Perspective Exploration

- [Claude AI Conference](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-AI-Conference): Simulated conference in which agentic personas (HR leads, CEOs, doctors, artists, sceptics) each deliver a three-minute talk on "AI in 2026", rendered with TTS.
- [Claude Change My View](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Change-My-View): Workspace for challenging personal beliefs through AI-generated counterarguments and rebuttals.
- [Panel Of Claude](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Panel-Of-Claude): Exploratory model running multiple agents as a panel debate.
- [Perspective Finder Prompt](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Perspective-Finder-Prompt): Claude Code workspace for finding people who hold specific viewpoints within a policy debate, surfacing voices that keyword search misses.

## Communications & Writing

- [Agentic Book Writing](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Agentic-Book-Writing): Pattern spec for writing full-length reference and instructional books with Claude Code, using teams of subagents and the repository as shared memory, through to a print-on-demand paperback.
- [AI Video Production Template](https://github.com/danielrosehill/AI-Video-Production-Template): Per-project workspace skeleton for producing one AI-generated video; the state half of a pair whose operational half is the `ai-video-producer` plugin (scripting, image-to-video and lip-sync pipelines).
- [Claude Book Workspace Template](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Book-Workspace-Template): Workspace scaffold implementing the Agentic Book Writing pattern: a `book.toml` manifest, spec and interview folders, binding prose and graphics style guides, and a status script for subagent-driven drafting.
- [Claude Website Update Sender](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Website-Update-Sender): Automated workflow for sending polished update emails about website changes via Resend MCP.
- [Declaude](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Declaude): Personalized text rewriting rules that consolidate into a slash command for refining AI-generated documentation.
- [RTL Conformity Skills](https://github.com/danielrosehill/RTL-Conformity-Skills): Instruction-only agent skills that keep Hebrew, Arabic, Farsi and Urdu text right-to-left on every surface an agent writes to (Gmail, Resend, Google Docs/Sheets/Slides) and verify the setting took. Works in Claude and ChatGPT.
- [Writing Editing Plugin](https://github.com/danielrosehill/writing-editing-plugin): Early standalone Claude Code plugin with slash commands for proofreading, style editing and text transformation.

## Context and Personalization

- [AI Dev Repo Template 1](https://github.com/danielrosehill/AI-Dev-Repo-Template-1): GitHub template repository pre-seeded with every AI Dev Workspace Primitive as a stub, with instructions for the user or agent to fill each one in.
- [AI Dev Repo Template Oct 2025](https://github.com/danielrosehill/AI-Dev-Repo-Template-Oct-2025): October 2025 template for AI-assisted development with a layered `CLAUDE.md` hierarchy that guides the agent through project stages.
- [AI Dev Workspace Primitives](https://github.com/danielrosehill/AI-Dev-Workspace-Primitives): Index of root-level `UPPERCASE.md` context primitives for AI-assisted repos (`SPEC.md`, `RULES.md`, `TOOLS.md`, `SECRETS.md`, `GROUNDING.md` and more), each published as its own repo and injectable via `CLAUDE.md`/`AGENTS.md`.
- [Batch ClaudeMD Repo Creator](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Batch-ClaudeMD-Repo-Creator): Automation workspace for batch-adding CLAUDE.md files across multiple GitHub repositories.
- [Claude Code Repo Managers ClaudeMD](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Code-Repo-Managers-ClaudeMD): Pre-configured CLAUDE.md templates for managing different repository types.
- [Claude Context Analysis 0526](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Context-Analysis-0526): Redacted point-in-time dump of `/context` from a heavily-pluginned Claude Code session, analysing where the context budget actually goes and what is eagerly versus lazily loaded.
- [Claude Foundations](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Foundations): Index of the user-level layer of a Claude Code setup, treated as one system — entrypoint, reference context, habits and discovery — covering what loads before any task is known.
- [Claude Model Identifier](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Model-Identifier): Prompt template for verifying the correct Claude model variant at conversation start.
- [Claude Spend Approval Limit](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Spend-Approval-Limit): Paste-ready CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md snippet that gives an agent a spending approval limit: it spends freely on paid APIs below a tunable threshold, and above it must estimate the cost, offer a cheaper route and wait for approval.
- [Claude User Context Pattern](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-User-Context-Pattern): Depersonalised reference pattern for organising user-level `~/.claude/` context: a lean top-level `CLAUDE.md` that routes to topical `context/*.md` files (system environment, git rules, MCP usage, file organisation, etc.) loaded only when relevant.
- [ClaudeMD Turnstile](https://github.com/danielrosehill/ClaudeMD-Turnstile): Pattern for maintaining separate CLAUDE.md files for developers and for end users of the same repository.
- [CONTEXT.md](https://github.com/danielrosehill/CONTEXT.md): Workflow methodology for separating human-authored context from structured AI agent briefings.
- [Habits Of Claude](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Habits-Of-Claude): Splits a user-level system prompt into one file per standing habit, assembled into a pasteable block and a JSON index. Ships skills to install a subset into any CLAUDE.md and to reconcile drift when the prompt and the repo disagree.
- [Home Folder Claude MD](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Home-Folder-Claude-MD): Working CLAUDE.md for a home directory on an Ubuntu Linux desktop.
- [Linux Desktop ClaudeMD Seeder](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Linux-Desktop-ClaudeMD-Seeder): Automatically generates contextual CLAUDE.md files across a Linux desktop filesystem.
- [My Tone Of Voice](https://github.com/danielrosehill/My-Tone-Of-Voice): Annotated corpus of writing samples used as ground truth for a personal writing style, with reusable methodology for building a tone-of-voice reference for AI agents.
- [Private And Public Claude MD](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Private-And-Public-Claude-MD): Tools for managing public and private CLAUDE.md files with security-focused git configuration.
- [Split Claude MD Pattern](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Split-Claude-MD-Pattern): Pattern for splitting a home-level CLAUDE.md into directives plus on-demand context files, optimised for context handling.
- [State Of Claude Context 0426](https://github.com/danielrosehill/State-Of-Claude-Context-0426): Q&A notes on where context bloat accrues given the current shape of the Claude Code harness and its primitives.
- [The User Voice Types](https://github.com/danielrosehill/The-User-Voice-Types): CLAUDE.md snippets and slash commands telling Claude to silently infer around transcription errors from voice typing and stray keystrokes from one-handed or distracted typing.

## Financial Planning

- [Claude FX Pair Analyst Template](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-FX-Pair-Analyst-Template): Claude Code workspace for FX pair analysis — historical data, quant and vol modelling, geopolitical context, and Typst PDF reports.
- [Israel Mortgage Research Skills](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Israel-Mortgage-Research-Skills): Work-in-progress skills basket for buyer-side Israeli residential mortgage research — track mix, Bank of Israel rules, DSR/LTV limits and bank quirks — before verified skills are folded into the Israel agent-skills plugin.
- [Israel Property Research Skills](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Israel-Property-Research-Skills): Work-in-progress skills basket for Israeli property due diligence (Tabu extracts, building files, usage permits, comparables), aimed at non-professional buyers and tenants.

## Health & Wellbeing

- [Claude ADHD Research Workspace](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-ADHD-Research-Workspace): Research notebook investigating ADHD medication access, structured for sustained Claude-assisted enquiry.
- [Claude Mental Health Templates Index](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Mental-Health-Templates-Index): Subindex of Claude Code templates, plugins and workspaces for mental health work a person does on their own material: organising events, tracking therapy, preparing for appointments.
- [Claude Therapy Workspace Template](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Therapy-Workspace-Template): GitHub template for working through one bounded personal issue with Claude Code — a career situation, a relationship, a bereavement — with sessions, threads and timelines kept in one workspace per issue.

## Ideas & WIP

- [Agent Context Harness](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Agent-Context-Harness): Idea: a per-turn router that sends each message to the current task, an existing parallel worker or a new session, keeping unrelated tasks out of one agent's context.
- [Claude Background Hook Planner](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Background-Hook-Planner): Placeholder for planning a Claude Code background hook.
- [Claude MD Experiments](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-MD-Experiments): Empty placeholder for experiments with `CLAUDE.md` structure.
- [Claude Skills Model 0526](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Skills-Model-0526): Stub for planning notes on the plugins and skills mechanism (May 2026).
- [Claude Voice Notifier](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Voice-Notifier): Planning repo for Claude placing a real outbound phone call to deliver a one-time, task-specific spoken message on the user's behalf.
- [Israel Medication Research Skills](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Israel-Medication-Research-Skills): Stub workspace for agent skills that check medication availability in Israel for patients, to be folded into the Israel agent-skills plugin.
- [Voice Note Task Classifier](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Voice-Note-Task-Classifier): Planned multi-label classifier that routes voice-note transcripts to task-specific subagents (email, calendar, shopping list, to-do, dev spec), each holding one MCP tool.

## Legal

- [Claude Case File](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Case-File): Claude Code template for building version-controlled containers for legal files and case material.

## MCP

- [AI Tools Plugin](https://github.com/danielrosehill/ai-tools-plugin): Early standalone Claude Code plugin with slash commands for AI tool management and MCP server configuration.
- [Claude Code MCP Command Generator](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Code-MCP-Command-Generator): Generator for creating MCP server configuration commands for Claude Code.
- [Claude Code MCP List](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Code-MCP-List): Curated index of MCP servers organized into 14+ categories for extending Claude Code.
- [Claude MCP Guidelines](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-MCP-Guidelines): Home-folder CLAUDE.md snippet giving an agent guidance on which MCP server to reach for.
- [Claude Meta MCP Slash](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Meta-MCP-Slash): Template `/install-mcp` slash command that routes MCP server installations across multiple MetaMCP instances using a tiered preference system.
- [How-To-MCP](https://github.com/danielrosehill/How-To-MCP): Guide for instructing AI agents on how to provision and manage MCP server connections according to user-specific preferences, with a tiered decision matrix.
- [MCPM Claude Code Docs](https://github.com/danielrosehill/MCPM-Claude-Code-Docs): Documentation for integrating Claude Code with MCPM external MCP server manager.
- [Smithery Claude Code MCP Jumpstarter](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Smithery-Claude-Code-MCP-Jumpstarter): Curated collection of 35+ MCP servers with interactive installer across 15+ categories.

## Miscellaneous

- [Agent Reference Workflows](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Agent-Reference-Workflows): Index of repositories that each record one agentic workflow being run end to end on a real task, including the wrong turns, as reference material for designing plugins.
- [AI Ideation Runs](https://github.com/danielrosehill/AI-Ideation-Runs): Public archive of structured AI ideation sessions run via Claude Code — each `/run` takes a topic and saves a dated batch of ideas with name, summary, category, feasibility/impact ratings, considerations, and next steps.
- [AI Memory Planning 0426](https://github.com/danielrosehill/AI-Memory-Planning-0426): Planning notes and architecture diagrams exploring three complementary methods for building a personal AI memory system over a vector store — passive distillation from chat, agentic interviews, and manual curation.
- [AliExpress Israel Skill](https://github.com/danielrosehill/AliExpress-Israel-Skill): Staging repo for AliExpress skills (Israel buyer focus) before they ship in the Israel Shopping plugin: scraper changes, locale handling and Affiliate API signing.
- [An Ode To Claude](https://github.com/danielrosehill/An-Ode-To-Claude): Workspace tracking a blog post through iterative drafting and revision, keeping every iteration, diff, and supporting context.
- [Android Media Importer](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Android-Media-Importer): Claude Code plugin for moving or copying media off a connected Android phone using user-defined mappings, MIME-based routing, and optional date-folder and orientation-split layouts.
- [Claude Code Bugs And FRs](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Code-Bugs-And-FRs): Staging area for Claude Code bug reports and feature requests before filing upstream at anthropics/claude-code.
- [Claude Code Changelog Notes](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Code-Changelog-Notes): Ad-hoc close readings of selected entries from the upstream Claude Code changelog, with generated PDFs and categorised JSON per version.
- [Claude Code Context Feature Requests](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Code-Context-Feature-Requests): Feature requests for improving Claude Code's context handling capabilities.
- [Claude Code Hacks](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Code-Hacks): Small tricks and temporary workarounds for Claude Code, each timestamped because the harness usually closes the gap quickly.
- [Claude Code Notes](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Code-Notes): Running notebook of techniques for getting more out of Claude Code.
- [Claude Code Plugin (Meta)](https://github.com/danielrosehill/claude-code-plugin): Meta-plugin for managing Claude Code configuration, slash commands, and agent development.
- [Claude Code Plugins Marketplace](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Code-Plugins): Centralized marketplace for discovering and installing Claude Code plugins — source of truth for the [Plugins section](./plugins.md).
- [Claude Friction Points](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Friction-Points): Dated public notebook of friction points encountered across Claude Code, the desktop and web apps, and the API, with point-in-time documentation snapshots used as grounding.
- [Claude Interview](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Interview-062325): Transcript from an Anthropic user research interview on AI tools and adoption.
- [Claude Is Awesome](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Is-Awesome): Template for creating curated resource lists with automated formatting and badge generation.
- [Claude Israel](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Israel): Index of people and projects building with Claude, including Claude Code, in Israel.
- [Claude Meta Dorker](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Meta-Dorker): Agent-readable search manifests documenting advanced URL parameters for websites, written for AI agents rather than human readers.
- [Claude Repo Jumper](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Repo-Jumper): System prompt and skill notes for keeping repository boundaries clean during agentic development.
- [Claude Spec Starter](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Spec-Starter): Pattern for AI-assisted development that starts from a single long user prompt and refines it into a spec.
- [Claude User Manual](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-User-Manual): Plugin for generating personalized user manuals and private documentation for codebases.
- [Claude Voice Mode Notes 300426](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Voice-Mode-Notes-300426): Notes on the Claude Code voice mode feature.
- [Claude Workspace Reshaping 190426](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Workspace-Reshaping-190426): Plan and records from the April 2026 refactor that turned roughly 100 standalone Claude workspace template repos into cluster plugins: inventory, clusters, conversion log and deletion list.
- [Github Index Maintainer](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Github-Index-Maintainer): Claude Code-powered maintenance tool, with agents and slash commands, for a hierarchy of GitHub index repos (master index, index of indices and subindices).
- [Israel Agent Skills Dev Index](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Israel-Agent-Skills-Dev-Index): Index of the Israel agent-skills ecosystem: released Claude Code plugins, the work-in-progress skills workspaces that feed them, and related indexes.
- [Israel Phonebook Manager](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Israel-Phonebook-Manager): Claude Code plugin for recording Israeli phonebook entries in Google Contacts — counter versus call-centre hours, Shabbat and chag closures, seasonal timetables, and numbers that do not connect from abroad.
- [Local Claude Plugin Install Research](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Local-Claude-Plugin-Install-Research): Research and notes on installing Claude Code plugins locally rather than through the marketplace.
- [New Turn Claude Hook](https://github.com/danielrosehill/New-Turn-Claude-Hook): Tool that determines whether to continue an AI conversation or start fresh for optimal context.
- [Non-Code Claude Code](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Non-Code-Claude-Code): Showcase of creative Claude Code applications beyond traditional software development.
- [Responsible Agent Skill Development](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Responsible-Agent-Skill-Development): Draft code of practice for publishing agent skills that touch the open web, separating the runtime information a skill needs from the research an author gathered about a site's defences.
- [Skill Creation Research](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Skill-Creation-Research): Research and notes on designing and authoring Claude Code skills.

## Multi-Agent Tooling

- [Agent Briefing Gateway](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Agent-Briefing-Gateway): Design model for an orchestration agent that buffers a human from a batch of working sub-agents — one consolidated brief per cycle, a budgeted override channel, and resumable approval gates.
- [Agent Handover Demo](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Agent-Handover-Demo): Pattern for handing tasks between code-generation agents working on different machines through shared handover docs, giving supervising humans an audit trail of what each agent did.
- [Agent Junction](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Agent-Junction): MCP server enabling encrypted peer-to-peer communication between Claude Code instances on localhost or LAN.
- [Claude Agent Picker Pattern](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Agent-Picker-Pattern): Framework for assembling context-optimized multi-agent crews with minimal overlap.
- [Claude Agent Workspace Generator](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Agent-Workspace-Generator): Launchpad for creating standardized workspace templates conforming to the Agent Workspace Model v1.1 spec, with slash commands to generate, validate, and publish new workspaces.
- [Claude Air Traffic Control](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Air-Traffic-Control): Workspace model for one operator running agentic AI across many repositories all day, borrowed from air traffic control: a voice-first shift manager routes work across concurrent Claude Code sessions. Published as a 26-page typeset document.
- [Claude Development Agents](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Development-Agents): Curated toolkit of 74+ Claude Code configurations for development workflows and multi-agent coordination.
- [Claude Fleet Traffic Shaper](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Fleet-Traffic-Shaper): Specification for a local proxy that assigns priorities to concurrent Claude Code sessions and shapes their aggregate traffic, so rate limiting degrades background work instead of landing at random. Includes a prior-art survey of the multi-agent proxy and queueing landscape.
- [Claude Plugin Workspace Vault](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Plugin-Workspace-Vault): Architecture for Claude Code plugins that do sustained work: a public plugin, a private workspace instantiated from a template repo, and a vault at `~/.claude-plugins/<name>/` for user data.
- [Claude Skill Definer](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Skill-Definer): Multimodal workspace for defining Claude Code skills from voice notes, videos, images and text, or written specs.
- [Claude Sub-Agent Network](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Sub-Agent-Network): Collection of system prompts and configurations for development, operational, and creative tasks.
- [Claude Vault Idea](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Vault-Idea): Idea capture for a meta-plugin holding a personal vault of plugins and MCP servers, activated selectively per project to mitigate eager plugin description loading at user level.
- [Claude Workspace Setup Helper](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Workspace-Setup-Helper): Interactive tool for discovering, selecting, and cloning Claude Workspace templates.
- [Cool Claude Code Stuff](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Cool-Claude-Code-Stuff): Curated collection of Claude Code projects and resources organized by category.

## Plugins

- [Adb Ops](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-ADB-Ops-Plugin): ADB (Android Debug Bridge) operations — onboard a phone, map folders, import media, capture screenshots, manage bloatware with a persistent log, and connect over Wi-Fi with automatic reconnect.
- [Agent Exchange](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Agent-Exchange): Two-way file exchange between you and Claude: from-human/ and from-agent/ folders, a CLAUDE.md block so Claude uses them unprompted, and a small explorer app (with launcher) locked to that folder, with new-file badges and read receipts.
- [Agentic Dev Workflows](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Agentic-Dev-Workflows): Agent dev workflows: UI friction fixes, release patterns. Any platform: options-then-build for UI friction, sprint or release-to-test release patterns pinned to CLAUDE.md.
- [AI Attribution](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-AI-Attribution-Plugin): AI transparency — document human vs AI contributions, add attribution, audit provenance.
- [AI Engineering](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-AI-Engineering-Plugin): Prompt engineering — craft, eval, catalog, version, search prompts, with library/factory variants.
- [AI Model Research](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-AI-Model-Research-Plugin): Research, discover, compare, and evaluate AI models on OpenRouter — backed by the bundled Model-Scout MCP server for live catalog data with caching. Subsumes the standalone open-router-model-research plugin and the Model-Scout-MCP server. 11 skills cover lookup, capability filtering (tools, vision, audio), recommendation, head-to-head comparison, deep evaluation, workload cost projection, and finding cheaper alternatives.
- [AI Video Producer](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-AI-Video-Producer-Plugin): Drive an AI-generated video project end-to-end: creative brief, model selection, character sheets, script, storyboard, generation pipelines (text-to-image-to-video, voice-to-lip-sync, text-to-video, upscale), clip assembly, and final export. Ships fal.ai/Replicate/MiniMax MCP servers and fal-js + WaveSpeed Python SDK runners.
- [Air Quality Toolkit](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Air-Quality-Toolkit-Plugin): Look up current and historical air quality, calculate AQI from raw pollutant readings, and run modelling utilities. Defaults to WAQI with fallbacks to OpenAQ and AireLibre.
- [Aliexpress Israel Skills](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Aliexpress-Israel-Skills): AliExpress shopping skills for Israel-based buyers — honest deep search that resolves true SKU prices behind anchored and bundle cards, fast-delivery-to-Israel filter, locale preference with drift guard (default EN/USD), Choice-first search, Israeli-reviews filter, landed cost, findings export (JSON/Markdown/PDF) and the $75 de-minimis across listings and cart.
- [Aliexpress Shopper](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Aliexpress-Shopper): Browser-driven AliExpress shopping assistant for Claude in Chrome. Bundles userscripts (Find Similar, Hide Combo Deals) and skills/commands that drive aliexpress.com directly in the user's browser session — search, read current listing, compare open tabs, apply filters, hide bundles, and find similar items. Scope is global aliexpress.com (any locale/currency) and visual/interactive shopping, not headless scraping or programmatic API flows.
- [Amazon](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Amazon-Plugin): Amazon.com marketplace research — verified price, stock, rating, seller and specs read from the listing rather than the search grid; Prime-aware delivery dates checked against the ZIP they were actually rendered for; filtered signed-in search with tested extractors, a marketplace profile and a durable brand allowlist.
- [Anonymisation Assistant](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Anonymisation-Assistant-Plugin): Anonymise sensitive documents (whistleblower disclosures, harassment diaries, incident reports) by replacing identifying details while preserving narrative integrity.
- [Audio Production](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Audio-Production-Plugin): Audio production — normalize, VAD, transcribe, diarize, podcast assembly, with engineering/podcast/transcript variants.
- [Audio Voice Id](https://github.com/danielrosehill/audio-voice-id-plugin): Speaker diarization, voice enrollment, and identification for audio files — builds a local voiceprint library with optional cloud replication.
- [Avp Music Video](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-AVP-Music-Video-Plugin): Audio → branded music video (avp): waveform, logo, karaoke. Install audio-visualizer-python, pull logo/colours/font from a repo into a brand kit, render an MP3 (e.g. from Suno) through JSON templates (waveform, spectrum bars, logo pulse, 9:16), burn in karaoke lyrics from LRC/SRT, and encode small with AV1 by default.
- [Background Removal](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Background-Removal-Plugin): Remove image backgrounds via rembg — single-pass, two-pass cleanup, batch mode, and KDE Dolphin right-click integration.
- [Backup Planner](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Backup-Planner-Plugin): Plan, document, and implement a backup and data-protection strategy for the current project — from architecture discovery through script generation and restore drills.
- [Batch Optical Archivist](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Batch-Optical-Archivist-Plugin): Plan and burn batch M-Disc / BD-R / DVD archives from a source directory on Ubuntu, with copy multipliers for offsite duplicates. Wraps growisofs, xorriso, and dvd+rw-mediainfo; optional K3B handoff for manual fallback.
- [Book Writing](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Book-Writing-Plugin): Write a full-length reference or instructional book with teams of subagents — definition, planning, research, parallel chapter drafting, review, graphics and publication. Organised so no single agent is ever handed the whole book, because quality degrades long before a context window fills; consistency is carried by a style guide, per-chapter briefs and a continuity ledger instead of by shared context. Authorship only — print geometry hands off to kdp-publishing.
- [Brainstorm Solutions](https://github.com/danielrosehill/brainstorm-solutions-plugin): When you hit a wall, spin up a research workspace to brainstorm solutions — captures the blocker, what you tried, and kicks off deep research
- [Browser Data Capture](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Browser-Data-Capture-Plugin): Streamline programmatic data ingestion against sites and apps that don't ship a documented API — capture network traffic (HAR, mitmproxy, or live tab via claude-in-chrome), map endpoints, infer schemas, and produce a draft OpenAPI spec you can build a stable client against. Ships skills for per-domain map documents, version-controlled storage in a private GitHub repo, and good-faith vulnerability disclosure if a finding turns up incidentally. White-hat use only.
- [Budgeting](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Budgeting-Plugin): Personal budgeting — log transactions, categorize, forecast, track goals, monthly reports.
- [Business Idea Eval](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Business-Idea-Eval-Plugin): Evaluate, refine, and develop business ideas through structured lenses — VC review, TAM, B2B/B2C fit, assumptions, objections, hardware feasibility, dev specs, timelines, social impact — plus an LLM council pattern (subagents or Karpathy clone), synthesis, and Typst PDF outputs for internal and public-facing docs.

Captures the full thread from a chatgpt.com URL, a shared link, or an official export archive, then normalizes it to JSON and renders Markdown or a styled Typst PDF with user and assistant turns marked, artifacts (canvas docs, images, code) extracted, cited sources collected, and conversation metadata recorded. Includes a two-pass redaction skill and a conversation-to-context workflow that writes transcripts into a repo's context/ folder.
- [Comparison Artifacts](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Comparison-Artifacts): Software evaluation tables, scoring and quadrants: tick/cross or short-descriptor feature tables, weighted scoring from your stated priorities, and 2x2 quadrant charts, rendered to Markdown, Typst or SVG from one data file and written into the document you're drafting.

- [Contact Support](https://github.com/danielrosehill/contact-support-plugin): Contact a vendor's support desk from a registry of verified, dated contact routes rather than recalled ones — ticket URLs and which support plans can reach them, abuse and fraud addresses taken from mailto hrefs rather than page text, per-tier response windows, priority vocabulary, escalation ladders with SLA claim deadlines, pre-contact checks, and the plausible routes that turn out to be dead. Records the user's account identity and where credentials live (a pointer, never the secret), drafts the request with the identifiers the desk will demand, sends it through whichever channel is actually reachable, logs the ticket and chases it when the window elapses. Ships verified for Twilio only; extend with support-add-service. Work in progress — concept stage.
- [Content Writing](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Content-Writing-Plugin): Content writing — draft, proofread, version, publish, style guides, with writing/blog/opinion/document variants.

- [Dead Drop](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Dead-Drop): Asynchronous agent-to-agent messages between Claude Code sessions working in different repositories. Agent A writes a markdown message into repo B's a2a/ folder and pings B by SendMessage if it is running; B's SessionStart hook lists open messages, B acts on them, sets any reminders the message asks for in its own scheduler, and records what it did in the same file. For long tasks the sender keeps one living message current (revision: counter) and asks the reader to re-check it on an interval (watch: 30m). No server and no shared meeting place: the target repo's folder is the mailbox. Breakout (an idea that needs its own new repo) and same-repo handover are message kinds.
- [Debugging](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Debugging-Plugin): Debugging — capture logs, isolate issue, diagnose error, track bugs, with code/system/issue variants. Includes a KDE hotkey utility for capturing live system bugs.

- [Network Cups](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Network-CUPS-Plugin): Discover, diagnose, and print to networked CUPS printers from Claude Code. Wraps the lan-mcp-cups MCP server and adds LAN discovery (avahi/Bonjour, arp-scan) plus ufw firewall sanity checks.
- [Network Tmp](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Network-Tmp-Plugin): Overflow /tmp to a capped, self-wiping NFS share on a home server. For laptops whose /tmp is a small tmpfs (RAM) or whose disk is tight: an ext4 image exported over NFS, mounted on demand with a local-disk fallback, expired hourly after 24 h. Skills to set it up, route large temporary files there, and report and clean it.
- [New Task Split](https://github.com/danielrosehill/New-Task-Split): Auto-/clear on a new task: local ONNX classifier moves unrelated prompts to a fresh session. claudehook trial launcher, install, toggle, update-model, remove.
- [Nfc Ops](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-NFC-Ops-Plugin): NFC tag operations using libnfc — read, write, inspect, password-protect, and bulk-write from CSV with manual tag-by-tag feed.
- [Noise Pollution Analysis](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Noise-Pollution-Analysis): Document indoor noise pollution and analyse recordings with ffmpeg, sox and aubio: hums, tones, drone, impacts, isolation from background.
- [Novelty Text Editor](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Novelty-Text-Editor-Plugin): Rewrite text in deliberately ridiculous styles — Shakespearean, medieval, archaic, chaos-case, over-salesy, platitude-stuffed, pseudobot, plus length transforms (elongate / truncate). Nine no-config skills for stylistic mischief.
- [Obd Diagnostics](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-OBD-Diagnostics-Plugin): Read OBD-II data from an ELM327-class adapter, normalise it to JSON, and use it to diagnose faults and plan vehicle maintenance. WIP.
- [Obs Mgmt](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-OBS-Plugin): Manage OBS Studio on Linux from Claude Code: detect install type (native/Flatpak/Snap/AppImage), enable and validate obs-websocket, ship a bundled obs-mcp MCP server for programmatic OBS control, back up configs to a user-defined folder, and install third-party OBS plugins.
- [Opnsense Mgmt](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Opnsense-Mgmt-Plugin): Manage an OPNsense router/firewall via SSH and the OPNsense API — guided first-run onboarding, firewall rule inspection, network debugging, and host/log diagnostics. Per-host config is stored outside the plugin so the same install works across multiple environments.
- [Os Sync Agent](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-OS-Sync-Agent): Hardware-aware desktop-to-laptop environment sync for Ubuntu/Debian. Snapshots packages (apt/snap/flatpak/pip/conda/ollama) and dotfiles from a base machine and a remote machine over SSH, then produces an incremental install/remove/sync plan rather than a perfect clone. Ships /sync-os command and sync-environments skill.
- [Passive Aggressive Pa](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-PA): Passive-aggressive PA system. Claude barks status updates over a speaker; if ignored, escalates across the house via Home Assistant or MQTT. Includes pre-recorded voice packs, RGB signal bulb, full-screen flash overlay, and a quiet-mode skill that translates natural-language pause/schedule requests.
- [Personal Context](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Personal-Context-Plugin): Builds and maintains a persistent, portable background context layer about the user — intake interview, ingestion of material they already have, gap analysis, scoped retrieval, maintenance and export. Plain markdown entries in a store the user owns, read through declared scopes and sensitivity levels; explicitly does not use model-managed memory. Ships the Portable Context Contract so issue-scoped workspaces can read it without re-asking who the person is.
- [Personal Planning](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Personal-Planning-Plugin): Personal life planning — log entries, review progress, set goals, with diary/health/family/house-search/preparedness/personal-dev/inbox variants.
- [Pii Scanner](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-PII-Scanner-Plugin): Scan files, directories, or git repositories for personally identifiable information — credentials (gitleaks), generic PII (Microsoft Presidio), and matches against a user-maintained personal PII inventory (names, addresses, family, IDs) stored locally.
- [Pipewire Audio](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Pipewire-Skills-plugin): Claude Code skills for taming Pipewire/Wireplumber audio on Linux — manage default devices, persistent device-priority rules, per-app routing, mic level checks, and EasyEffects bindings.
- [Planning Docs](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Planning-Docs-Plugin): Keep a repo's decision log and plans lean: record numbered decisions, and compact old decisions and plans into in-place summaries so agents read the live state, not the history.
- [Plugin Vault](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Vault): Meta-plugin for per-project activation of dormant plugins and MCP servers from a personal vault. Mitigates user-level eager skill description loading.
- [PR & Media Work](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-PR-Media-Work-Plugin): PR and media monitoring — scan coverage, summarize press, draft responses, comms strategy, with monitoring/response/strategy variants.
- [Procurement Tools](https://github.com/danielrosehill/procurement-tools-plugin): Product research and procurement skills with a particular focus on technical specification conformance — does this part actually meet the requirement, and can you show your working. Marketplace-agnostic: spec definition from a vague want or a photograph, annotated search vocabulary, versioned spec-as-code, manufacturer datasheet retrieval, cross-region part-number equivalence, conformance evaluation matrices, bills of materials and RFQ packages. Plus the surrounding process: intake, research, compare, evaluate, recommend, market-check, spec-driven market landscape surveys, live price/delivery scanning through your own VPN egress, preference memory and hardware-rig profiling. Hands off to the marketplace-specific plugins (shopping, israel-shopping, amazon, aliexpress-israel-skills) once a question becomes about a particular shop.
- [Programmatic Doc Generation](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Programmatic-Doc-Generation-Plugin): Build programmatic document generation pipelines — Typst templates for local batch rendering, plus integration scaffolding for n8n and cloud rendering services (Carbone, PDFMonkey, APITemplate, DocRaptor, Docmosis, Adobe Doc Gen).
- [Proxmox Mgmt](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Proxmox-Mgmt-Plugin): Manage a Proxmox VE host via SSH and the Proxmox API — guided first-run onboarding, VM/CT lifecycle, storage and ZFS inspection, log review, and update workflows. Per-host config is stored outside the plugin so the same install works across multiple Proxmox environments.
- [Pseudospam Filter](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Pseudospam-Filter-Plugin): A second spam filter for pseudospam (outreach produced at scale, dressed up as personal): parallel Haiku judges taught by your own Gmail example labels, a review-queue label instead of deletion, a reply queue for genuine mail, plus sender blocks, unsubscribe replies and tracking-pixel/DNS blocking.
- [Rclone Manager](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Rclone-Manager): Routine rclone admin: install/update, add/list/edit/delete remotes, add/list/edit/remove mounts as systemd user units, config backup (one-off or automatic to a private git repo on a timer), migrate config between machines with path rewriting, and docs lookup.
- [Repo To Content](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Repo-To-Content-Plugin): Convert GitHub repos into polished content (PDF, white paper, internal doc, public-docs publication) via Typst, with optional AI banner generation and multi-target publishing.
- [Report Analyst](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Report-Analyst-Plugin): Skeptical analyst toolkit for long reports — READ/SKIM/SKIP verdicts, structured extraction (arguments, findings, stats, case studies, key snippets), and an opinionated executive summary. Built-in Jaded Report Reader persona that refuses credit for filler.
- [Research Space](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Research-Space-Plugin): Research — source log, summarize, deep-dive, export, with deep-research/technical/osint/georeaction/stack/ecosystem/competitor/purchasing/general-research-workspace/obsidian-vault variants. The obsidian-vault variant scaffolds the research loop as a working Obsidian vault (committed .obsidian/ config, frontmatter schema, wikilinks, templates, canvas). Includes a 30-agent tech research team for hardware/software stack evaluations (folded in from Claude-Tech-Research-Team).
- [Resource List Builder](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Resource-List-Builder-Plugin): Build, maintain, and audit curated GitHub resource lists (Awesome-style indexes) with AI-driven categorisation, alphabetised tables, and dynamic shields.io badges.
- [Resume Typesetter](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Resume-Typesetter-Plugin): Manage a resume as JSON Resume schema data and render it with custom Typst templates. Onboard, iterate, fork variants, and version.
- [Rtl Email](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-RTL-Email): Send email in right-to-left scripts (Hebrew, Arabic, Farsi, Urdu) that actually renders RTL. Plain-text email carries no direction metadata, so RTL bodies render LTR in many clients and multi-part numbers like account references reorder. Ships dir=rtl HTML templates, separate personal and business send skills inheriting saved signature profiles, and one-time signature setup. Works with Google Workspace MCP or Resend.
- [Rudder](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Rudder): Claude-Rudder — collection of utilities to smoothen Claude Code UX. Context-gate workflow, log/blocker capture, plugin/MCP primitives, repo & docs spawning, and the canonical user-data storage convention. (Session-hopping skills moved to Claude-Hopper.)
- [Schedule Manager](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Schedule-Manager-Plugin): Personal schedule, task, and meeting management. Routes mixed brain-dumps into Google Calendar (events) and Todoist (tasks); manages agenda/minutes Google Docs linked to events; produces wrapup logs and morning briefs. 22 skills covering Calendar/Todoist CRUD, firehose routing, task<->event migration, priority/date hygiene, and agenda/minutes lifecycle.
- [Security Auditor](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Security-Auditor-Plugin): Register machines and run repeatable Claude-Code-driven security audits over SSH, with timestamped reports and per-machine profiles.
- [Session Hopper](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Hopper): Claude-Hopper — skills for hopping between discrete terminal-bound Claude Code sessions on Linux. Spawn new instances (Konsole), hand off context (full / clipboard / with-tasks), resume from handovers, and pick up leftover work.
- [Session Restore](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Session-Restore): Terminal crashed? Reopen the lost Claude Code sessions: finds the ones that died together and resumes each in its repo, in one Konsole window of split panes (or tabs, or windows). Also keeps Konsole asking before a window close kills them.
- [Shopping](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Shopping-Plugin): Region-specific consumer shopping primitives — find products, compare local vendors, check availability, and generate ranked purchase recommendations. Ships variant scaffolds per supported region and a provisioning skill for fresh shopping workspaces. Marketplace-specific research (Amazon US, AliExpress Israel) now lives in dedicated per-marketplace plugins; the marketplace-plugins skill is the roster.
- [Site Skill Builder](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Site-Skill-Builder-Plugin): Site skills built by watching a site in your own signed-in Chrome — network-first discovery, a surface survey or your own URL list, a skill roster for approval, then skills that survive UI changes, keep the session alive, clean up after themselves and probe for drift. Semantic handles only. Every observation is classified publishable, private, or never-recorded.
- [Skill Or Not](https://github.com/danielrosehill/To-Skill-Or-Not-To-Skill): Ask 'should this become a skill?' before every task: a five-step checklist (repeatable, automatable, already ours, already someone else's, else create and validate it) plus an installer that puts the heuristic in your user-level CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md.
- [Smart Home](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Smart-Home-Plugin): Smart home — Home Assistant, Snapcast multi-room audio, Plex media server ops, with HA/audio/media-server variants.
- [Snap It](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Snap-It-Plugin): Manage BTRFS snapshots via snapper and btrfs from Claude Code — create, list, diff, rollback, and prune subvolume snapshots. Includes /snap and /snap-before commands for one-shot and pre/post-paired snapshots around risky changes.
- [Social Feedback](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Social-Feedback-Plugin): Check what people are actually saying about a topic, product, or provider by searching curated social-discourse sources (Reddit, Hacker News, Stack Exchange, Trustpilot, YouTube, Lobsters).
- [Sop Writer](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-SOP-Writer-Plugin): Project-scoped authoring tools for Standard Operating Procedures and decision flowcharts. Scaffold from templates, embed Mermaid/D2 diagrams, compile to printable PDFs via Typst, and assemble multi-document binders with TOC and page numbers.
- [Spec Led Certification](https://github.com/danielrosehill/spec-led-certification-plugin): Choose a professional certification specification-first rather than market-first. create-workspace stands the search up as a private GitHub repo instantiated from the Spec-Led-Certification template, so it survives the machine and its git history shows when the scorecard was frozen relative to when the research ran. Three entry points for the three situations — start-search onboards and runs the full intake, rerun-search archives the previous run and reports what moved in the market, update-profile changes what is stored about you and marks the scorecard stale. Intake writes five dated profile files — subject, current position read from evidence, learning preferences, objectives and standing positions, money and time — a weighted scorecard is derived from those alone and frozen before any credential is looked up, then candidates are scored against it with a source tier and confidence tag on every number. Hard requirements exclude rather than score down. Emits a ranked comparison and a Typst PDF whose figures are computed from the CSVs at compile time. All state is written to the working directory, never to an agent memory store.
- [Spec Starter](https://github.com/danielrosehill/spec-starter-plugin): Spec-driven development workflow for Claude Code: turn unstructured project briefs (especially voice transcripts) into a versioned spec, modular context, and a CLAUDE.md scaffolded into your current repo.
- [Stack Evaluator](https://github.com/danielrosehill/stack-evaluator-plugin): Component-level review of a project's technology stack, not its code — records the stack to docs/stack/ with the run date, checks each component for end-of-life and currency, finds architectural gaps (caching, backups, queues, rate limiting, observability), flags redundancy and over-engineering against the real workload, then emits a sequenced revision proposal and an execution brief. Re-runnable per repo with persistent decisions and finding history.
- [Stack Search](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Stack-Search-Plugin): Spawn a new stack search workspace from the Claude-Stack-Research-Workspace template — clone, name, create GitHub repo, and kick off the structured intake interview
- [Start Here](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Start-Here): Find, navigate and download Daniel Rosehill's GitHub repositories: search all 1,000+ public repos, find the curated topic index for a subject, and clone one repo or a filtered set. Reads the Start-Here index JSON instead of crawling GitHub.
- [Style Switcher](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Style-Switcher): Persona-recipe library for swapping Claude into themed personalities (Daredevil, Jaded IT, Reluctant, Chatty, Philosophical, Operational, Dubious, Hyper Creative, Approval Needed, Visionary, Claude FM, Claude Bouncer). Each recipe ships a banner image and sound effect, and applies via either a managed block in ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md or a repo-sandbox mode that holds the user CLAUDE.md aside.
- [Synology Mgmt](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Synology-Mgmt-Plugin): Manage a Synology NAS via SSH — guided first-run onboarding, share/volume inspection, storage health, and file operations. Per-host config is stored outside the plugin so the same install works across multiple NAS environments.
- [Synthetic Data](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Synthetic-Data-Plugin): Generate synthetic datasets from schemas, real data, or LLM-driven personas. Tabular fit-and-sample (SDV: GaussianCopula, CTGAN, TVAE), Faker/Mimesis schema generation, deterministic PII swap, LLM-driven real-to-synth conversion for unstructured records, and SDMetrics-based quality/privacy evaluation (plus embedding-based leakage checks for text).
- [System Recovery Mode](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-System-Recovery-Mode): AI-assisted Linux system recovery — slash commands and agents (diagnose, logs, network, disk, services, packages) for diagnosing and fixing a broken system. Pairs with an optional GRUB/systemd installer that boots a minimal recovery TTY straight into Claude CLI.
- [Task Queuer](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Task-Queuer-Plugin): Repo-based task queueing system with categorisation and prioritisation. Scaffolds a planning/ folder, logs tasks (single, batch list, or voice-transcribed), buckets them by category, and hands prioritised work off to the repo's orchestration agent.
- [Taxonomy Creation](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Taxonomy-Creation-Plugin): Generate taxonomy and lookup tables (countries, currencies, languages, US states, timezones, custom domain taxonomies) and load them into Postgres, SQLite, MySQL, or export to CSV/JSON/SQL seed files. For data engineers, CMS builders, and eval pipeline authors.
- [Teach This Repo](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Teach-This-Repo-Plugin): Uses a real code repository in reverse for developer education: assesses the learner's profile, builds a teaching plan grounded in the repo, writes lessons and file-by-file analyses with code samples drawn from the source, supports interactive Q&A, and typesets any of it as a PDF via Typst.
- [Tech Research](https://github.com/danielrosehill/tech-research-plugin): Technology research — competitive analysis, technical documentation retrieval and research workflows.
- [Technical Docs](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Technical-Docs-Plugin): Technical documentation — READMEs, reference docs, changelogs, environment docs, with api-reference/code-docs/environment-docs/dev-notebook variants.
- [Test Project Ideator](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Test-Project-Ideator-Plugin): Generates specifications for practice/dummy development projects tailored to the user's learning objectives, technology stack, and proficiency level in each language or tool.
- [Text Corpus Analysis](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Text-Corpus-Analysis-Plugin): Skills for analyzing large text corpora — topic modeling (BERTopic with temporal evolution), NER, categorization into fixed taxonomies, bottom-up category derivation, multi-level taxonomy design, word frequency, synonym clustering for voice-note/STT corpora, parametric stats, and metadata↔content correlation. Three execution lanes (classical NLP, local LLM via Ollama, cloud LLM via OpenRouter) with explicit cost-awareness: mandatory pre-run estimates for >1k-doc LLM passes, two-pass cheap→premium pattern, embeddings+clustering preferred over pairwise LLM comparison.
- [Text To Speech Toolkit](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Text-To-Speech-Toolkit-Plugin): Skills for preprocessing text for TTS engines — SSML conversion, ElevenLabs markup (grounded in live ElevenLabs prompting docs), TTS safety review, and manual prosody addition. Non-destructive by default: edits land in an edited/ folder alongside an unchanged original/ copy.
- [Therapy Tracking](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Therapy-Tracking-Plugin): Organising therapy reflections — pre/post-session notes, goal tracking, and turning voice-memo transcripts into structured problem summaries. Not therapy: organises notes only. Workspace data lives outside the plugin so the same install survives plugin updates.
- [Timemark](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Timemark-Plugin): Timemark stamp-camera photo import that recovers the field data the app withholds. No Timemark export carries both the full-resolution image and the values, so imports are gated on having the originals and the Photosheet XLSX, then joined on capture timestamp. Outputs are XMP burned into the files or a self-contained archive of images, JSON sidecars and an index.
- [Transcription Pipeline](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Transcription-Plugin): Audio transcription — denoise, VAD, transcribe (Gemini/AssemblyAI/Whisper), clean, structure, export, with cloud and local engine backends.
- [Travel Packing](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Travel-Packing-Assistant-Plugin): Make optimal use of a baggage allowance on an international itinerary — research each carrier's real checked, cabin and personal-item allowance per segment with a source and a confidence level for every figure, compute the binding limit that governs the journey, inventory what is carried by weight, reconcile scale readings against the inventory, solve the allocation to bags and packing cubes, price every way out of being over, and rank an emergency leave-behind list by cost per kilogram saved. Renders a one-page airport counter card and a per-bag packing list as PDF via Typst and as Markdown. One trip workspace per itinerary.
- [Ubuntu Admin](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Ubuntu-Admin): Administer Ubuntu machines, desktop or server, locally or over SSH: health and diagnosis, packages (apt/snap/flatpak), systemd services and logs, Docker, storage and backups, networking, hardware and GPU drivers, displays, fonts, codecs, shell and dev environments. Supersedes linux-desktop-mgmt, linux-server-mgmt and sysadmin-homelab.
- [Ubuntu Security](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Ubuntu-Security): Host security for Ubuntu desktops and servers: ufw firewall (setup, status, scoped allows, removal, diagnosing blocks), ClamAV/rkhunter/Lynis/AIDE scanning and schedules, security audits and updates, SSH keys and sshd config, fail2ban, YubiKey and fingerprint login, TLS certificate checks. Supersedes linux-av-manager and security-checkup.
- [Unofficial MCP Builder](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Unofficial-MCP-Builder-Plugin): Author and maintain unofficial MCP servers for third-party APIs that don't ship one. Generate a server from the vendor's API docs verified against the live API with your own key, detect upstream drift on a schedule, and smoke-test against real operations. Bound by a committed api-surface.yaml recording what the API actually does versus what its docs claim. Publishes to npm.
- [User Context File](https://github.com/danielrosehill/User-Claude-MD-Plugin): Manage the user-level ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md and its chunked ~/.claude/context/ directory — audit, chunk, list, and edit global Claude Code user context for token efficiency.
- [User Manual](https://github.com/danielrosehill/user-manual-plugin): Personal user manuals and private documentation for codebases, with PDF output.
- [User Memory](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-User-Memory-Plugin): Backend-agnostic persistent user memory for Claude Code. Ships a save/recall/commit contract with personal/work context routing; defaults to the `memory` upstream on an MCP gateway, or bring your own memory MCP via a workspace memory-config.md.
- [Userscript Development](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Userscript-Development-Plugin): Develop, test, and publish Tampermonkey userscripts — scaffolding, in-browser validation via Claude in Chrome, README generation, and version bumping.
- [Vendor Liaison](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Vendor-Liaison): Report bugs, request features, disclose security to vendors: per-vendor channel data with routing rules, a private overlay for your preferred channels and personal contacts, duplicate checks before filing. Vendors: Claude Code, 1Password, Whisperian.
- [Video Editing](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Video-Editor-Plugin): Video editing, transcoding, video processing, and multimedia workflow automation. Two-tier workspace (index + project), per-user data store, and a growing set of ffmpeg/MLT/Kdenlive primitives.
- [Visual Communications](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Visual-Communications-Plugin): Plan and prompt-engineer AI-generated visuals (images, diagrams, video) for whitepapers, blog posts, and long-form content. Six skills cover project onboarding, visual ideation, prompt generation, project listing, fal-ai execution, and a resolution/style reference.
- [Voicenotes](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Voicenotes-Plugin): Voicenotes.com: search, read, create; unofficial text and date-range export, tags, audio import. Not affiliated.
- [Workspace Foundational](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Workspace-Foundational-Plugin): Foundational workspace — setup, context management, report parsing, inventory, template discovery, with 6 variants.
- [Zigbee Home Maintenance](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Zigbee-Home-Maintenance-Plugin): Maintain a home Zigbee network — onboard MQTT broker, coordinator (SMLight / Sonoff / ConBee / etc.), and Home Assistant; manage credentials, network exports, and routine maintenance.

## Productivity & Planning

- [Agent-Assisted Purchase Research Index](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Agent-Assisted-Purchase-Research-Index): Index of templates, skills and demos for agent-driven purchase research, built on decoupling the requirements spec from the current market.
- [Agentic Purchase Pipeline](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Agentic-Purchase-Pipeline): Staged, agent-supported process for evaluating any purchase over about $50: capture the spec, find the requirements, survey the market, then score candidates against the spec.
- [Claude Decision Mapper](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Decision-Mapper): Codifies the iterative spec-refinement loop used with Claude for builds, hardware purchases and home-lab decisions — draft spec, correction, refinement — as reusable skills.
- [Claude Shopping Demo 2](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Shopping-Demo--2): Model workspace for a Claude shopping research tool customised by shop whitelist and task, with input and output folders.
- [Claude Shopping Eval Demo](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Shopping-Eval-Demo): Demo of Claude Code as a consumer purchasing assistant: a written spec plus retailer catalogue screenshots go in, a ranked recommendation report comes out (worked example: a portable Bluetooth speaker).
- [DVR Transcriber](https://github.com/danielrosehill/DVR-Transcriber): Work-in-progress CLI and workspace for importing recordings from a digital voice recorder, organising them into dated folders, classifying them with AI and transcribing them.

## Research

- [Claude A2A Research](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-A2A-Research): Research notes on Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocols and how they relate to Claude.
- [Claude Deep Research Model (Notes / Documentation)](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Deep-Research-Model): Framework for iterative deep research using Claude with voice pipeline and structured outputs.
- [Claude Dork](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Dork): Agent that generates platform-specific search dorks across Google, Reddit, Twitter/X, and more.
- [Claude For Mayor](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-For-Mayor): AI-assisted municipal platform for a candidate who doesn't exist: a researched, cited and costed Jerusalem mayoral manifesto built with Claude Code. Sibling of MK Claude.
- [Claude For OS Mgmt Research](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-For-OS-Mgmt-Research): Research workspace on using Claude and Claude Code for operating system management.
- [Claude Open Router Model Research Plugin](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Open-Router-Model-Research-Plugin): Claude Code plugin for researching, filtering, comparing, and evaluating models on OpenRouter, pulling the live catalogue without an API key.
- [Claude Tooling Prior Art](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Tooling-Prior-Art): Public record of build-vs-adopt scans for Claude Code tooling: does a plugin, MCP server or skill already exist for a given requirement, or is it blue sky? Each scan keeps the searches — including the empty ones — against a closed verdict set with dated decay.
- [Github Repo Org Question](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Github-Repo-Org-Question): Ongoing research notebook, built on the Claude research workspace template, on managing a large personal GitHub fleet: organisation, multi-machine sync, bulk lifecycle operations and launcher UX.
- [Israel Election 2026 Vote Decision](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Israel-Election-2026-Vote-Decision): Voting-decision workspace for the October 2026 Knesset election: a voice note of personal priorities becomes a weighted rubric, Claude agents research and score every list on the ballot, and the result ships as ranked PDF reports and an interactive Hugging Face Space.
- [Israel Research Skills](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Israel-Research-Skills): Instruction-only plugin of Israel-specific research skills — Kol Zchut rights, Home Front Command guidelines, travel warnings, medicines, government offices and opening hours — that runs in Claude and ChatGPT.
- [Live Typing UX Research](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Live-Typing-UX-Research): Claude-assisted research workspace cataloguing the UX of live voice typing as a keyboard replacement on the desktop: interaction patterns, inference approaches and tool comparisons.
- [MK Claude](https://github.com/danielrosehill/MK-Claude): AI-assisted political platform experiment for Israel: a detailed, researched and costed manifesto for a party that doesn't exist, written in public with Claude Code.
- [Obsidian Research Vault Template](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Obsidian-Research-Vault-Template): GitHub template for AI-assisted research that produces a working Obsidian vault: frontmatter and wikilink conventions are set up so the agent's notes populate the graph, backlinks and properties.

## Slash Commands

- [AI-Human Attribution Adder](https://github.com/danielrosehill/AI-Human-Attribution-Adder): Adds AI/human attribution sections to README files for transparent tool usage documentation.
- [Claude App Optimiser](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-App-Optimiser): Slash command deploying a sub-agent for codebase optimization and dead code removal.
- [Claude Calls The Shots](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Calls-The-Shots): Flips Claude Code into autonomous, action-first mode — ships a per-session `/calls-the-shots` slash command plus an optional always-on snippet injected into `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`.
- [Claude Code Linux Desktop Slash Commands](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Code-Linux-Desktop-Slash-Commands): System administration slash commands for Linux desktop environments.
- [Claude MD Chunk](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-MD-Chunk): Slash command that condenses bloated CLAUDE.md files to essentials and organizes supplementary context into a structured `agent-context/` folder.
- [Claude Slash Commands](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Slash-Commands): General-purpose slash command library for various Claude Code workflows.
- [Document As You Go](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Document-As-You-Go): Drop-in system prompt and slash command that make coding agents capture what they discover — undocumented APIs, auth flows, dead ends — instead of losing it when the session ends.
- [General Dev Plugin](https://github.com/danielrosehill/general-dev-plugin): Early standalone Claude Code plugin with slash commands and agents for code generation, refactoring and general development.
- [Git GitHub Plugin](https://github.com/danielrosehill/git-github-plugin): Early standalone Claude Code plugin with slash commands and agents for Git version control and GitHub repository management.
- [No Wheel Inventions](https://github.com/danielrosehill/No-Wheel-Inventions): Slash commands encouraging use of existing libraries instead of building custom solutions.
- [Split Context Setup](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Split-Context-Setup): Slash command that prunes a repo's `CLAUDE.md` to essentials and scaffolds a topic-based `context/` store, an ingestion pipeline for raw materials, and subagents for context maintenance.

## Systems Administration

- [Bash Alias Manager Claude](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Bash-Alias-Manager-Claude): Workspace for managing bash aliases with YADM synchronization support.
- [Claude Code Bash Aliases](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Code-Bash-Aliases): Collection of bash aliases for common Claude Code operations on Linux.
- [Claude Dolphin & Konsole Actions](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Dolphin-Konsole-Actions): KDE Dolphin right-click context menu actions (service menus) for launching Claude Code in various Konsole window layouts, including single terminal, split panes, and multi-instance grids.
- [Claude Konsole Launcher](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Konsole-Launcher): Launch utility for pairing Claude Code with Konsole on KDE Plasma.
- [Claude LAN Manager 0126](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-LAN-Manager-0126): GUI concept for Claude-driven LAN management, covering device discovery and network operations.
- [Claude Linux Desktop Manager Notes 0426](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Linux-Desktop-Manager-Notes-0426): Planning workspace for managing a Linux desktop with an agentic CLI, running raw notes through a refine/analyse/workflow pipeline.
- [Claude OS](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-OS): Multi-plugin installation and setup utility for orchestrating everyday Linux desktop use through Claude Code.
- [Claude OS Playbook](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-OS-Playbook): Template using Claude Code as an Ansible stand-in for repetitive environment setup and supervision.
- [Claude Rescue](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Rescue): Concept for deploying Claude Code into recovery shell environments for AI-assisted system repair.
- [Claude Rescue Pi](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Rescue-Pi): Raspberry Pi jump host running the Claude Code CLI over Cloudflare Access and Tailscale as an emergency recovery surface for a Linux workstation.
- [Claude System Recovery Mode](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-System-Recovery-Mode): Custom GRUB boot entry integrating Claude CLI into Linux system recovery workflows. Projects specifically targeting KDE Plasma desktop integration and Linux desktop workflows with Claude Code.
- [Conda Management Plugin](https://github.com/danielrosehill/conda-management-plugin): Early standalone Claude Code plugin with slash commands for managing Conda environments and packages.
- [Desktop Ops Workspace Template](https://github.com/danielrosehill/desktop-ops-workspace-template): Per-machine, local-first SQLite log of everything the agent installed, fixed or diagnosed on a Linux desktop, so later sessions can query history before acting. Pairs with `linux-desktop-plugin`.
- [Dolphin AI Actions](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Dolphin-AI-Actions): KDE Dolphin right-click service menus that open the selected directory in Claude Code or Codex, in normal or permissive mode.
- [KDE Claude Runner](https://github.com/danielrosehill/KDE-Claude-Runner): Plan for a KDE-native runner that starts and supervises Claude Code sessions from the desktop.
- [LAN Manager Plugin](https://github.com/danielrosehill/lan-manager-plugin): Claude Code plugin that turns a LAN into working memory: devices, services, operating systems, ports and topology captured in a greppable knowledge store that grows as you and Claude discover things.
- [Server Management Plugin](https://github.com/danielrosehill/server-management-plugin): Early standalone Claude Code plugin with slash commands for server monitoring, deployment and administration.
- [Synology Manager Plugin](https://github.com/danielrosehill/synology-manager-plugin): Claude Code plugin for administering a Synology NAS over SSH, with guided first-run setup, persistent context and commands for shares, volumes, mounts and storage monitoring.

## Technology & Hardware

- [Claude Monitor Research](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Monitor-Research): Ergonomic and geometric research into a display for running a grid of at least eight concurrent Claude Code sessions, measured in text cells rather than inches, plus the software layer for navigating the grid.
- [Claude Pad](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Claude-Pad): Dedicated macropad for driving Claude Code — approve, stop, new session, transcript navigation — with a host-driven status LED that lights when Claude is waiting on you.
- [Home Media Planner](https://github.com/danielrosehill/Home-Media-Planner): Non-code planning workspace for a home media setup: ideas, voice notes and reference material refined into requirements and decisions.
